030/**
031 * NotifyEvent $eventHandle <params> 
032 * 
033 */
034public class SellToFleet extends BaseCommandPlugin {
035        
036        public static float RESUPPLY_FLEET_SELL_VALUE_MULT = 1f;
037        public static float SCAVENGER_SELL_VALUE_MULT = 0.25f;
038        public static float MAX_QUANTITY_AS_FRACTION_OF_CARGO_CAPACITY = 0.5f;
039        
040        
041        protected CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet;
042        protected CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
043        protected TextPanelAPI text;
044        protected OptionPanelAPI options;
045        protected CargoAPI playerCargo;
046        protected MemoryAPI memory;
047        protected InteractionDialogAPI dialog;
048        protected Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap;
049        protected PersonAPI person;
050        protected FactionAPI faction;
051
052        protected boolean buysStuff;
053        protected float valueMult;
054        protected float maxCargo;
055        protected float maxFuel;
056        
057        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
058                
059                this.dialog = dialog;
060                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
061                
062                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
063                if (command == null) return false;
064                
065                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
066                
067                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
068                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
069                
070                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
071                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
072                
073                person = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
074                faction = person.getFaction();
075                
076                if (dialog.getInteractionTarget() instanceof CampaignFleetAPI) {
077                        fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
078                        valueMult = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF_RATE);
079                        if (valueMult <= 0f) {
080                                fleet = null;
081                        }
082                        maxCargo = (int) fleet.getCargo().getMaxCapacity() * MAX_QUANTITY_AS_FRACTION_OF_CARGO_CAPACITY;
083                        maxCargo -= getAlreadyBoughtCargo();
084                        maxFuel = (int) fleet.getCargo().getMaxFuel() * MAX_QUANTITY_AS_FRACTION_OF_CARGO_CAPACITY;
085                        maxFuel -= getAlreadyBoughtFuel();
086                }
087                
088                if (command.equals("willBuyStuff")) {
089                        return willBuyStuff();
090                } else if (command.equals("selectStuff")) {
091                        return selectStuff();
092                }
093                
094                return true;
095        }
096
097        protected boolean willBuyStuff() {
098                return fleet != null && fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_BUYS_STUFF) &&
099                                (maxCargo >= 1 || maxFuel >= 1);
100        }
101        
102        protected int getAlreadyBoughtCargo() {
103                if (fleet == null) return 0;
104                String key = "$alreadyBoughtCargo";
105                return fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(key);
106        }
107        
108        protected void addAlreadyBoughtCargo(int qty) {
109                if (fleet == null) return;
110                String key = "$alreadyBoughtCargo";
111                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
112                mem.set(key, mem.getInt(key) + qty);
113        }
114        
115        protected int getAlreadyBoughtFuel() {
116                if (fleet == null) return 0;
117                String key = "$alreadyBoughtFuel";
118                return fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(key);
119        }
120        
121        protected void addAlreadyBoughtFuel(int qty) {
122                if (fleet == null) return;
123                String key = "$alreadyBoughtFuel";
124                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
125                mem.set(key, mem.getInt(key) + qty);
126        }
127        
128
129        protected boolean selectStuff() {
130                CargoAPI copy = Global.getFactory().createCargo(false);
131                for (CargoStackAPI stack : playerCargo.getStacksCopy()) {
132                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = stack.getResourceIfResource();
133                        if (spec == null) continue;
134                        if (spec.isPersonnel()) continue;
135                        if (spec.isNonEcon()) continue;
136                        if (spec.isMeta()) continue;
137                        
138                        copy.addFromStack(stack);
139                }
140                copy.sort();
141                
142                copy = playerCargo;
143                final CargoAPI copy2 = copy;
144                
145                
146                final float width = 310f;
147                dialog.showCargoPickerDialog("Select goods to transfer", "Confirm", "Cancel", true, width, copy, new CargoPickerListener() {
148                        @Override
149                        public boolean withLogistics() {
150                                return true;
151                        }
152                        @Override
153                        public boolean withReset() {
154                                return true;
155                        }
156                        @Override
157                        public void performReset(CargoAPI selected) {
158                                // the dialog already cancels the transaction, nothing special to do here
159                        }
160                        
161                        @Override
162                        public QuickTransferStackSizeAdjustor getStackSizeAdjustor() {
163                                return new QuickTransferStackSizeAdjustor() {
164                                        @Override
165                                        public float returnDesiredStackSize(float currQuantity, CargoStackAPI clickedStack, 
166                                                                        CargoAPI from, CargoAPI other) {
167                                                if (from == playerCargo && clickedStack != null) {
168                                                        if (clickedStack.isFuelStack()) {
169                                                                float remaining = maxFuel - other.getFuel();
170                                                                if (remaining >= 1f) {
171                                                                        return (int)Math.min(currQuantity, remaining);
172                                                                }
173                                                        } else {
174                                                                other.updateSpaceUsed();
175                                                                float remaining = maxCargo - other.getSpaceUsed();
176                                                                if (remaining >= 1f) {
177                                                                        return (int)Math.min(currQuantity, remaining);
178                                                                }
179                                                        }
180                                                } else if (other == playerCargo && clickedStack != null) {
181                                                        if (clickedStack.isFuelStack()) {
182                                                                float extra = from.getFuel() - maxFuel;
183                                                                if (extra >= 1f) {
184                                                                        return (int)Math.ceil(Math.min(currQuantity, extra));
185                                                                }
186                                                        } else {
187                                                                other.updateSpaceUsed();
188                                                                float extra = from.getSpaceUsed() - maxCargo;
189                                                                if (extra >= 1f) {
190                                                                        return (int)Math.ceil(Math.min(currQuantity, extra));
191                                                                }
192                                                        }
193                                                }
194                                                return currQuantity;
195                                        }
196                                };
197                        }
198                        
199                        @Override
200                        public CargoFilter getFilter() {
201                                return new CargoFilter() {
202                                        @Override
203                                        public boolean accept(CargoStackAPI stack) {
204                                                CommoditySpecAPI spec = stack.getResourceIfResource();
205                                                if (spec == null) return false;
206                                                if (spec.isPersonnel()) return false;
207                                                if (spec.isNonEcon()) return false;
208                                                if (spec.isMeta()) return false;
209                                                return true;
210                                        }
211                                };
212                        }
213
214                        @Override
215                        public boolean enableConfirm(CargoAPI selected) {
216                                if (selected.isEmpty()) return false;
217                                return selected.getSpaceUsed() <= maxCargo && selected.getFuel() <= maxFuel;
218                        }
219                        
220                        public void pickedCargo(CargoAPI cargo) {
221                                if (cargo.isEmpty()) {
222                                        cancelledCargoSelection();
223                                        return;
224                                }
225                                
226                                cargo.sort();
227                                cargo.updateSpaceUsed();
228                                
229                                addAlreadyBoughtCargo((int)cargo.getSpaceUsed());
230                                addAlreadyBoughtFuel((int)cargo.getFuel());
231                                
232                                Random random = new Random(Misc.getSalvageSeed(fleet));
233                                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
234                                        if (copy2 != playerCargo) {
235                                                playerCargo.removeItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), stack.getSize());
236                                        }
237                                        if (stack.isCommodityStack()) { // should be always, but just in case
238                                                int num = (int) stack.getSize();
239                                                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(stack.getCommodityId(), num, text);
240                                                
241                                                float retain = (int)(stack.getSize() * (0.35f + random.nextFloat() * 0.65f));
242                                                if (retain < 1) retain = 0;
243                                                stack.setSize(retain);
244                                        }
245                                }
246                                
247                                BaseSalvageSpecial.addExtraSalvage(fleet, cargo);
248                                
249                                float credits = computeCreditValue(cargo);
250
251                                if (credits > 0) {
252                                        playerCargo.getCredits().add(credits);
253                                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText((int)credits, text);
254                                }
255                                
256                                FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "SellToFleetFinished");
257                        }
258                        public void cancelledCargoSelection() {
259                        }
260                        public void recreateTextPanel(TooltipMakerAPI panel, CargoAPI cargo, CargoStackAPI pickedUp, boolean pickedUpFromSource, CargoAPI combined) {
261                        
262                                
263                                float opad = 10f;
264                                int credits = (int) computeCreditValue(combined);
265                                int quantity = (int) combined.getSpaceUsed();
266                                int fuel = (int) combined.getFuel();
267
268                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
269                                Color neg = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
270                                
271//                              panel.setParaFontOrbitron();
272//                              panel.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayName()), faction.getBaseUIColor(), 1f);
273//                              panel.setParaFontDefault();
274//                              panel.addImage(faction.getLogo(), width * 1f, 3f);
275                                panel.setParaSmallInsignia();
276                                panel.addPara("You will receive %s of the base value of the commodities sold.", opad, 
277                                                h, "" + (int) (valueMult * 100f) + "%");
278                                
279                                //panel.beginGridFlipped(width, 1, 40f, 10f);
280                                panel.beginGrid(width - opad, 1);
281                                panel.setGridFontSmallInsignia();
282                                //panel.beginGrid(150f, 1);
283                                
284                                boolean overCargo = combined.getSpaceUsed() > maxCargo;
285                                boolean overFuel = combined.getFuel() > maxFuel;
286                                
287                                panel.addToGrid(0, 0, "Cargo selected", "" + quantity + " / " + (int) maxCargo, overCargo ? neg : h);
288                                panel.addToGrid(0, 1, "Fuel selected", "" + fuel + " / " + (int) maxFuel, overFuel ? neg : h);
289                                panel.addToGrid(0, 3, "Credits: ", Misc.getDGSCredits(credits));
290                                panel.addGrid(opad + opad);
291                                
292                                if (overCargo || overFuel) {
293                                        panel.addPara("Selected goods quantity exceeds capacity of recipient.", neg, opad * 2f);
294                                }
295                                
296//                              panel.addPara("The total for the selected goods is %s.",
297//                                              opad * 1f, h,
298//                                              Misc.getWithDGS(credits) + Strings.C);
299                        }
300                });
301                
302                return true;
303        }
304
305        protected float computeCreditValue(CargoAPI cargo) {
306                float total = 0;
307                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
308                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = stack.getResourceIfResource();
309                        if (spec != null) {
310                                total += spec.getBasePrice() * stack.getSize();
311                        }
312                }
313                total *= valueMult;
314                return total;
315        }
316        
317        
318}
